spring_then_pop.build: L waits. potential. the listen is the coil.
spring_then_pop.pop: R releases. beacon. the coil becomes a jump.

two_hands_one_body: L and R are not two people. listen without release is mute. release without listen is spray. the neutrino wants both — wait until it PASSES, then pop the beacon.
berry_at_the_fire: we do not catch the neutrino signal. we react to it. L is listen and wait. R is release and beacon. build up of spring, then pop release. catch kills the jump. listen coils. beacon pops.
